description: This file implements a C++ class for monitoring and handling NetworkManager D-Bus events on a GNOME-based Linux system. It manages network interface state changes, WiFi scan results, IP address changes, and connection signals, providing callbacks and event handling for network status updates.

classes.name: NetworkManagerEvents
classes.description: A singleton class that manages D-Bus event monitoring for NetworkManager, handling network interface, WiFi, IP address, and connection events, and providing callback functions for these events.

methods.name: networkMangerEventMonitor
methods.description: Main thread function that sets up D-Bus signal handlers, monitors network devices, and runs the main event loop.

methods.name: startNetworkMangerEventMonitor
methods.description: Starts the network manager event monitoring thread and initializes D-Bus signal connections.

methods.name: stopNetworkMangerEventMonitor
methods.description: Stops the event monitoring thread and cleans up resources.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkManagerEvents.

methods.name: NetworkManagerEvents
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event loop and starts monitoring.

methods.name: ~NetworkManagerEvents
methods.description: Destructor that stops monitoring and cleans up.

methods.name: onActiveInterfaceChangeCb
methods.description: Callback invoked when the active network interface changes.

methods.name: onInterfaceStateChangeCb
methods.description: Callback invoked when a network interface's state changes.

methods.name: onWIFIStateChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when WiFi state changes.

methods.name: onAddressChangeCb
methods.description: Callback invoked when an IP address is acquired or lost.

methods.name: onAvailableSSIDsCb
methods.description: Callback invoked when WiFi scan results are available.

methods.name: setwifiScanOptions
methods.description: Configures whether WiFi scan results should be notified periodically.
